# `oaap app rehearsal`

list, extend or end rehearsals (RFC-0030).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app rehearsal [--days DAYS] [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                          {list,extend,sweep} [name]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | rehearsal instance |
| `--days DAYS` | extend by this many days (default 7) |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | yes |
| `extend` | yes |
| `sweep` | yes |
